text.p: Mircea Radulescu, coach of Universitatea Craiova soccer club which is languishing at the bottom of Romania's first division, resigned on Friday, club officials said.
The 54-year-old Radulescu, Romania's national coach in 1992 and 1993, submitted his resignation because the team's performance was below par, according to a club statement.
Universitatea Craiova, who reached the semifinals of the UEFA Cup in 1983, are lying in 14th place in the country's 18-strong first division.
The club lost their latest outing this week 3-0 to Universitatea Cluj.
